{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Check unique sites
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()

# Check if any site has a value not in site_1, site_2, site_3

print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {patient_duplicates}")
print(f"Unique sites in data: {sorted(unique_sites)}")

# Also check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}")"}
